postings.title: Customer Success Manager ( Groningen / Remote , 32-40 hours per week )
postings.description:
Customer Success Manager
Groningen / Remote
32-40 hours per week
€ 3.000 - € 4.000
At Zerocopter, we are on a mission to make the digital world a safer place. We help organisations protect themselves by combining smart technology with the skills of some of the best ethical hackers out there. From SaaS security tooling to hands-on testing, we cover a wide range of services - always with a human touch.
We bring our services together under one clear structure, with shared tools, simple processes, and a set of values that guide how we work. We believe in innovation, honesty - and we’re building a team that feels the same way.
We are Zerocopter
We bring together the best hackers in the world in a trusted network, giving you access to ongoing protection: Bug Bounty, Pentesting, Recon, and Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure - all integrated in one platform.
We’re not here to point fingers. We’re here to help.
Your Role: What You’ll Do
As a Customer Success Manager, you will play a key role in ensuring that our customers get the most value from our services. You will be the go-to person for clients post-sale, leading onboarding, driving adoption, and fostering long-term relationships. You’ll act as a trusted advisor, a problem-solver, and a connector between clients and internal teams.
Responsibilities
Guide customer onboarding and ensure smooth implementation of our solutions.
Monitor customer satisfaction, usage, and adoption.
Conduct regular check-ins, QBRs (Quarterly Business Reviews), and status updates.
Proactively identify and mitigate risks in customer relationships.
Spot upsell/cross-sell opportunities and collaborate with Sales.
Collect and relay customer feedback to Product and Support teams.
Maintain accurate customer documentation and reporting.
Help optimise internal customer-facing processes.
Your Profile
Education & Certifications
Bachelor's or Master’s degree (e.g. in Communication, IT, Business Administration).
Affinity with cybersecurity is essential.
CSM certifications (e.g. SuccessHACKER, Gainsight) are a plus.
Customer-Centric Background
Minimum 2 years in a customer-facing role, preferably in IT or SaaS environments.
Comfortable managing multiple accounts simultaneously.
Experience working with CRM tools and analysing customer data.
Commercial & Communication Skills
Able to translate customer needs into actionable value propositions.
Experience recognising commercial opportunities.
Strong communication skills in both Dutch and English.
A team player who collaborates across sales, support, and delivery.
Skilled in engaging with both operational and strategic stakeholders.
Personal Traits
Structured and solutions-oriented.
Eager to learn and take ownership.
Service-minded and customer-obsessed.Proactive and confident in driving customer success.
What we offer
A central role in one of the Netherlands’ most respected cybersecurity organisations.
A hybrid working model — work remotely or at the office (you choose), but: with a weekly team day every Tuesday at our HQ in Groningen.
A dynamic environment with room for growth and innovation.Work alongside ethical hackers, engineers, and cyber specialists.
Competitive salary, pension plan is being developed, and a personal development budget.
Does this feel like a good match?
If so, we’d love to hear from you! Send your CV and a short motivation to menno@zerocopter.com .
We review applications as they come in.Not sure yet? No worries. If you’d like to learn more about the role, the team, or what it’s like to work at Zerocopter, feel free to reach out first - we’ll connect you with one of your future colleagues to help you get a clearer picture.
Menno Oomkens

postings.title: Cybersecurity Triage Specialist ( Groningen / Remote , 32-40 hours per week )
postings.description:
Cybersecurity Triage Specialist
Groningen / Remote
32-40 hours per week
€ 3.000 - € 4.000
At Zerocopter, we are on a mission to make the digital world a safer place. We help organisations protect themselves by combining smart technology with the skills of some of the best ethical hackers out there. From SaaS security tooling to hands-on testing, we cover a wide range of services - always with a human touch.
We bring our services together under one clear structure, with shared tools, simple processes, and a set of values that guide how we work. We believe in innovation, honesty - and we’re building a team that feels the same way.
We are Zerocopter
We bring together the best hackers in the world in a trusted network, giving you access to ongoing protection: Bug Bounty, Pentesting, Recon, and Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure - all integrated in one platform.
We’re not here to point fingers. We’re here to help.
Your Role: What You’ll Do
As a Triage Specialist, you are the first expert eye on incoming reports. You assess and validate the reported vulnerabilities, determine their severity, and ensure clear communication and quality throughout the triage process. You have strong communication skills in both Dutch and English, in both spoken and written form.
Responsibilities
Analyse incoming security findings and bug reports for severity, impact, and relevance.
Determine risk levels using industry standards (e.g. CVSS).
Validate reproducibility and technical details of submissions.
Track and document triage outcomes across our platforms (ZC.Next, Jira, etc).
Communicate clearly with researchers and clients on progress and resolution.
Contribute to quality guidelines, triage standards, and process documentation.
Identify trends and inefficiencies, and propose process/tooling improvements.
Work closely with ethical hackers, customer success, and platform engineers.
Your Profile
Education & Certifications
MBO+, Bachelor’s or equivalent in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field.
Certifications like OSCP, CPTS, CWES, BSCP, PJPT are a plus.
Experience with bug bounty or vulnerability coordination platforms (e.g. HackerOne, Bugcrowd, Zerocopter) is a strong advantage.
Technical Expertise
Understanding of OWASP Top 10, CVSS, vulnerability management practices.
Familiarity with security testing tools (e.g., Burpsuite)
Basic knowledge of networking, web and mobile applications, Linux & Windows environments.
Soft Skills
Analytical and detail-oriented — you spot false positives fast.
Strong communication skills (English & Dutch required).
Able to stay calm under pressure and act decisively.
Team player with a high sense of responsibility and integrity.
What we offer
A key role in one of the most respected ethical hacking platforms in the Netherlands and beyond.
Room to grow your skills and career in cybersecurity triage & operations.
Work with a team of hackers, engineers, and cyber specialists.
A hybrid working model — work remotely or at the office (you choose), but: with a weekly team day every Tuesday at our HQ in Groningen.
Flexible working (hybrid/remote), good tools, and real impact.
Salary based on experience, pension in development and learning budget.
Working within an international and mission-driven organisation.
Does this feel like a good match?
If so, we’d love to hear from you! Send your CV and a short motivation to menno@zerocopter.com .
We review applications as they come in.Not sure yet? No worries. If you’d like to learn more about the role, the team, or what it’s like to work at Zerocopter, feel free to reach out first - we’ll connect you with one of your future colleagues to help you get a clearer picture.

postings.title: Medior Pentester ( Groningen / Hybrid , 32-40 hours per week )
postings.description:
Medior Pentester
Groningen / Hybrid
32-40 hours per week
€ 3.750 - € 4.750
At Zerocopter, we are on a mission to make the digital world a safer place. We help organisations protect themselves by combining smart technology with the skills of some of the best ethical hackers out there. From SaaS security tooling to hands-on testing, we cover a wide range of services - always with a human touch.
We bring our services together under one clear structure, with shared tools, simple processes, and a set of values that guide how we work. We believe in innovation, honesty - and we’re building a team that feels the same way.
We are Zerocopter
We bring together the best hackers in the world in a trusted network, giving you access to ongoing protection: Bug Bounty, Pentesting, Recon, and Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure - all integrated in one platform.
We’re not here to point fingers. We’re here to help.
Your Role: What You’ll Do
As a Medior Pentester at Zerocopter, you are part of a fast-growing cybersecurity company operating at the intersection of platform-driven security and expert-led testing. You work within our Operations circle, alongside ethical hackers, developers, and assessment leads. This is where execution happens - where real security challenges are solved, and where our promises to clients turn into tangible outcomes.
You independently perform security assessments across applications, infrastructure, and cloud environments. At the same time, you help clients understand what matters, what to fix, and why. Your base location is flexible. We work hybrid by default, with regular presence in Groningen for team rhythm and client interaction. Before you apply
This role requires professional fluency in Dutch. You will also be expected to be present at our Groningen office on a regular base. Candidates must be based in the Netherlands or the EU and hold the right to work in the Netherlands without sponsorship.
Responsibilities
Performing security assessment (web, mobile, infrastructure, cloud) based on best practices and your own expertise
Writing clear, actionable reports with concrete recommendations
Advising clients during and after assessments
Supporting and mentoring junior pentesters
Contributing to the development of tooling, methodology and services
Sharing knowledge within the team and the wider community
Participating in research initiatives
Your Profile
Education & Certifications
At least 2 years of experience in pentesting (web, infra and/or cloud)
A completed HBO or WO degree in IT, cybersecurity or a related field
OSCP certification (required); OSCE / CRTO is a plus
Skills & experience
Experience with offensive tooling such as Burp Suite and, Kali Linux
Programming/scripting skills (e.g. Python, PowerShell, Bash)
Experience with vulnerability scoring using CVSS 3.1
Strong communication skills in both Dutch and English
A combination of ownership, analytical thinking and team spirit
The ability to work hybrid and switch between projects with clarity and focus
What we offer
A role with real ownership, responsibility and room to grow
A strong, multidisciplinary team focused on quality over volume
Coaching from experienced ethical hackers and leads
A competitive salary based on experience
Clear growth paths toward specialist or lead roles
The tools and setup you need to do your work properly
A working environment where your contribution directly shapes how Zerocopter grows
Does this feel like a good match?
If so, we’d love to hear from you! Send your CV and a short motivation to menno@zerocopter.com .
